name: 35301-sharegptdecode-8b1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params; the draft is a 1.24B LlamaForCausalLM with the same vocabulary.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 100 requests / 2400 s, warmup the first 20% by completion; `max-num-seqs: 1` matches the single in-flight request.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `request_format: plain`, single turn: `configs/data/sharegpt-80-llama31-seed123.jsonl`, 80 ShareGPT conversation openers (prompt tokens mean 243, max 993). Output is fixed at 512 tokens per request -- guidellm turns `output_tokens_count` into max_tokens=512 with ignore_eos=True -- and decoding is greedy at temperature 0.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on one H100, pairing an 8B model with a small draft model for 512-token replies.
launch:
# Keys go straight to this era's AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown one is a TypeError at construction.
# `max-num-seqs` and `enable-prefix-caching` are NOT this commit's defaults (256, on) -- they are
# declared, not incidental, and must not be dropped as redundant.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "draft_model", "model": "unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct", "num_speculative_tokens": 15, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1, "max_model_len": 2048}
max-model-len: 2048
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
